requirement.evidence: In no case shall the allowable rent increase exceed 4%. The allowable annual increase will not be permitted, if the dwelling is not in substantial compliance and/or if the landlord has not met the registration requirements as specified in this subsection 19:2-9.8.
requirement.note: The 12-month window and the tenant/owner change language are in the page's general paragraph. The advice to check registration with the Office of Rent Control is a minor addition.

key_value.evidence: In no case shall the allowable rent increase exceed 4%.
key_value.note: The 12-month period is stated in the preceding paragraph.

effective_date.evidence: The Rent Control Ordinance was amended on September 05, 2017.
effective_date.note: The 4% provision cites Ord. 6 PSF-A(S), 9-5-17, which is the adoption date. The document gives no explicit effective date, and the card does not explain the step from adoption to effectiveness.

status.evidence: In no case shall the allowable rent increase exceed 4%.
status.note: The page presents the cap as current law. The moratorium was rescinded on September 18, 2023.

coverage.note: Coverage is empty on the card.

citation.evidence: Pursuant to 19:2-3. Rent Increases. 19:2-3.1. Determination of Rents. In no case shall the allowable rent increase exceed 4%.
citation.note: The page cites 19:2-3 and Ord. 6 PSF-A(S), 9-5-17.
